tools.name: search_resources
tools.description: Search the marketplace by keyword and/or filters (network, asset, scheme, payTo, maxUsdPrice). Text queries rank by relevance; filter-only queries rank by 30-day call volume.

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Fetch one resource's full record by slug or numeric id: description, accepts[], output schema, quality signal, and agent-first metadata where the provider supplied it.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get just the price/accepts[] for a resource, without the full record — cheaper for an agent that only needs to decide whether it can afford something.

tools.name: discover_provider
tools.description: List every resource published by a given provider host.

tools.name: list_resources
tools.description: Paginated listing of every indexed resource, ranked by 30-day call volume (or recency with sort="recent").

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Catalog-wide totals: listings, resources, accepts, merchants, 30-day call volume, network/source breakdown.

tools.name: discover_agents
tools.description: Search or list the A2A agent registry — other agents’ cards (name, skills, provider, protocol version), not Agent Bazaar’s own.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Fetch one registered agent's full card by slug or numeric id.
